ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 85% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels forming the lobe centers and 15% low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the periphery and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region spanning the majority of both lobes. Low-intensity black bordering the entire trailing edge and leading edge tips. Symmetrical yellowish-brown mottling concentrated in the lower-central quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 42 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher amplitude 'peaks' and deeper 'valleys' (jaggedness) compared to the more uniform, low-amplitude serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a broad convex curve from the terminal tips toward the median notch. Leading edges show a slight posterior concavity leading to blunt, irregularly shaped terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular dark-on-white and light-on-white clusters visible, notably on the inner-medial region of the right lobe and scattered near the notch base.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel and unaligned linear grey-scale disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial section of the left lobe and diagonal linear marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Concentrated black scar tissue and irregular pigmentation mapping at the base of the median notch; terminal tips of both lobes show minor irregular pixel-loss/erosion.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown pixel staining/biofilm distributed across the high-intensity ventral surface, more concentrated on the lower-medial sections.
